description: List the user's CVs (resumes) on TakeMeUp.cv with their id, title, template, country format, status and editor link (on the website this includes an in-progress anonymous session). Use first in almost every task, to find the CV to work on. Returns an empty list for a new account.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: list_my_takemeup_cvs
title: List my CVs
